mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect temperatures around 75 degrees with overcast conditions near the Military Ridge State Trail.

The City of Verona has closed entries for the I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K-12. Community voting will officially open on July 28 and run through August 7 to determine the four winning designs that will be featured on stickers during the November election.

There is plenty to enjoy in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company throughout the day.
On July 13, the Verona Police Department responded to a call where a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for a first offense O-W-I after his vehicle was found stuck on a rock.
Make sure to stop by Culver's for the flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. They are open until 10:30 PM, so you have plenty of time to enjoy a delicious dessert.
